text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I take Narita Taishin to the infirmary
after she
suffers an injury during training.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Look, it's not a big deal. It'll probably
just heal on
its own.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Look, it's not a big deal. It'll probably
just heal on
its own.
choice_data_list: It'd be awful if that made it worse.
It'd be awful if that made it wors...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Oh, bug off!
choice_data_list: It'd be awful if that made it worse.
It'd be awful if that made it wors...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Do you really think I'm some frail wimp?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Is it because I'm shorter than the others?
Because
I'm tiny and weak? Is that it?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Well, I don't need you to!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Why don't you stop worrying and use
your time to
think up a training regimen?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she agrees to rest,
I'll happily think up
as many
regimens as she'd like, but...
choice_data_list: If I think about it, will you trea...
If I think it over, will you treat me?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not what I'm getting at! Are
you even
listening to me?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I don't even know why I bother with you...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin loses her will to keep
arguing and
consequently agrees to
receive treatment for her
injury.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I decide to place my trust in her,
as she's

probably the person who knows herself
best.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hmph. Should have started with that.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Oh, be quiet! I can keep going!
choice_data_list: It's that injury from earlier afte...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I can keep running! I have to... keep
running!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I understand her impatience, but it
would be
dangerous to let her continue.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I manage to calm her down and cut
training short
for the day.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant... You see?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Duh. No way in hell I'm gonna let
something that
small hold me back.
choice_data_list: Looks like your injury really is fine.
It really seems like you're comple...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta do more training than anyone
else if I
hope to beat them.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Sigh. You're such a nag.
choice_data_list: But I want you to take care of you...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Whatever. Stop hounding me and let me
train
already!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I won't have to deal with you hovering
over me all
the time once I get stronger.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite her complaints, Narita Taishin
finishes
the full training session.
